about: Topics for La Porte After Dark shorts, in order. 'leads' are where to start looking, not checked facts: every claim still needs two independent sources (PLAYBOOK.md, step 2). Statuses: todo, done, skipped (with a reason).

topics.what: The 1934 Dillinger escape from the 'escape-proof' Lake County Jail; voices in the cells today.
The legend of George Gipp's ghost in Washington Hall, and the real story of Gipp (1895-1920).
topics.notes: Say Gipp with a hard G: the storyboard needs no rule, LOCAL_SAY has Gipp -> Ghip.

topics.what: The September 1933 escape of ten men from the Indiana State Prison with smuggled guns, the break Dillinger is said to have arranged. Still an active prison: history only, no ghost story unless sources report one, no inmates or guards shown, 'view it from the road'.
leads: Indiana State Prison (Wikipedia, for its cited sources)
Indiana Historical Bureau or Indiana Department of Correction history pages
1933 newspapers on Chronicling America or Hoosier State Chronicles

topics.what: Tippecanoe Place, the Studebaker family's 1889 mansion, and the hauntings staff and guests report.
The 1858 Old Lighthouse and Harriet Colfax, who kept the light for decades. Only tell a ghost story if sources report one; otherwise a night-time history story.
leads: U.S. Coast Guard / National Park Service lighthouse histories

topics.what: The 1871 Porter County Sheriff's Residence and Jail (the Old Jail Museum) and the ghost tours held there.
leads: National Register of Historic Places listing
valpo.life on ghost tours for the Porter County Museum

topics.what: The 1878 Lake County Courthouse ('the Grand Old Lady') and the woman people say roams it.
leads: Crown Point Community Library, Haunted Crown Point
Lake County Historical Society / courthouse foundation history
topics.notes: Not right after the Crown Point jail short: space Crown Point out.
